name: SecuritySettings

states.name: Page Header & Title
states.description: The page header shows the Shield icon, title 'Security & Sandboxing', and subtitle description.

states.name: Security Profile Selector
states.description: Dropdown to select the active security profile. Options: Permissive, Standard, Strict, Custom. Selecting a built-in profile shows its description and AST fingerprint.
states.precondition: A built-in profile (not custom) is selected

states.name: Security Posture Visualization
states.description: A 7-layer bar chart showing the current profile's security scores. Each layer (L1:Compute through L7:Audit) has a colored bar indicating enforcement level: None (red), Cooperative (orange), Software (yellow), Kernel (green).

states.name: Custom Profile Editor
states.description: When 'Custom' profile is selected, a full sub-policy editor appears with sections for Network, Actions, Filesystem, Resources, and Credentials. Each section has appropriate form controls.

states.name: Features Section
states.description: Toggle switches for the three main security features: Credential Proxy, Network Mediation, and Security Audit Log.
states.precondition: Security Audit Log toggle is enabled

states.name: Audit Log Viewer
states.description: When audit logging is enabled, a scrollable table shows recent security audit events with summary badges, filter dropdown, refresh button, and JSON export button.
states.precondition: Security Audit Log toggle is enabled

states.name: AST 7-Layer Info Banner
states.description: An informational banner explaining the Agent Sandbox Taxonomy (AST) 7-layer model at the bottom of the page.

states.name: Action Buttons
states.description: Reset to Defaults and Save Security Settings buttons at the bottom of the page.

states.name: Visual Design & Typography
states.description: Dark theme styling with neutral-800 card backgrounds, blue-400 accents, and consistent text hierarchy.

states.name: Loading & Error States
states.description: The page handles loading, error, and success states appropriately.
states.precondition: A save or load operation has failed

description: Security & Sandboxing settings page. Configures agent sandboxing policies following the AST 7-layer defense model: compute isolation, resource limits, filesystem boundaries, network mediation, credential proxy, action governance, and audit logging. Supports three built-in profiles (permissive/standard/strict) plus a custom profile editor with full sub-policy configuration.
